decisive_items: T-cell receptor PCR: Matching clonal rearrangements identified in 3 skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample
Low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal (20x magnification)
Admixed atypical, irregularly contoured lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes
response.rationale: R3 is supported by clonal T-cell receptor rearrangements in skin and marrow, a CD8-predominant atypical lymphocytic infiltrate, and marrow involvement, consistent with mycosis fungoides with extracutaneous spread. R4 only accounts for the papular skin lesions and lymphohistiocytic infiltrate without addressing the systemic clonal and marrow findings.

rejected.why: Lacks the clonal TCR, marrow involvement, and CD8-predominant atypical phenotype; lymphomatoid papulosis is typically CD30+ and self-limited, not fitting this systemic presentation.
